newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 420 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 420 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 420 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 26 wheat, 137 corn, 231 soybean and 26 soymeal futures contracts traded along with 5 wheat call and 2 corn call options.
Corn was 1/4 cent per bushel lower, wheat 1/2 cent lower to 1/2 cent higher, soybeans down 1-3/4 cents, and soymeal down 10 to 20 cents a ton.
